logicalType.description: ODCS logical type, admin-declared; omitted when derived from the name.

logicalTypeOptions.description: ODCS `logicalTypeOptions` columns of this type inherit, admin-declared; omitted when derived from the name.

V3ConfigDataType.description: `Config/*.json` registry entity types — one array element each (the file itself is `V3ConfigX[]`, validated element-by-element the same way a `Tables/*.json` file validates as a single `V3Table`). `uuid` is optional for the same reason as every other entity: a new registry entry omits it and push assigns one. Rule-collection registries (`relation_rules.json`, `flag_rules.json`, `column_sorting_rules.json`) are edited in Specly, not the repo, so they have no type here.
